::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Key Validation Metrics:** 360° street-level somatic dataset ($n = 420$ segments) | MLLM perceptual stress scoring | Peri-urban microclimate correlation[cite: 1]
:::

## 1. Local / Urban Problem
Standard quantitative mobility models miss street-level thermal stress, acoustic friction, and perceived safety in rapidly urbanizing peri-urban territories such as San Juan de Ocotán[cite: 1].

## 2. Algorithmic & MR Workflow
Custom Python and Grasshopper pipelines process 360° street imagery through Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to map perceptual stress indices onto spatial networks[cite: 1].
